skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe cloud concepts such as services, infrastructure, platforms, storage, and security.
Explain the operation model of Hadoop.
Analyze the operational mechanisms of cloud services by integrating individual knowledge.
Apply learned knowledge to solve exercises and situations related to each topic.
Possess research skills to find, collect, synthesize, and analyze problems specific to the field.
Collaborate effectively with peers to solve specialized problems within deadlines.
Develop independent problem-solving abilities and teamwork skills to address specialized issues.
Have the ability to self-study and understand materials to complete assigned lessons and assignments.
Organize and coordinate group work to solve class problems.
Be aware of classroom organization and discipline, follow class rules, and have a sense of cooperation and personal responsibility for activities assigned by instructors.
